sources.title: mikecovlee/tinymixtral-it · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Fine-tuned for one epoch from the public mikecovlee/tinymixtral base on 2,168,835 deduplicated and eval-decontaminated English instruction conversations blended from public sources (Tulu3, OpenHermes, SlimOrca, OpenOrca, UltraChat, MetaMath, OrcaMath, OMI-Llama-2, SQuAD2, TriviaQA). Sequence packing to 1024 tokens, bf16, AdamW, lr 2e-5 cosine with 3% warmup.
